byPath.*: Quotes a car insurance policy: rates every driver, rates the policy by its riskiest driver, applies capped discounts and checks the underwriting rules
byPath.Driver: A listed driver: birth date, licence date, at-fault claims and violations of the last three years
byPath.DriverFacts: The age and the driving experience on the quote date, and whether the driver is claim-free
byPath.DriverRating: The age, experience and record factors of one driver, their product, and the underwriting findings
byPath.Policy: A policy quote: the quote date, the coverage, the deductible, the territory, the customer history, the vehicle and the drivers
byPath.PolicyDiscounts: The discounts earned, the discount rate within the cap and the discount amount
byPath.PolicyFacts: The years as a customer and the number of drivers
byPath.PolicyPremium: The annual premium after discounts and the monthly instalment
byPath.PolicyRating: The rate version, the base rate, the riskiest driver, the factor breakdown and the premium before discounts
byPath.Underwriting: The findings of all drivers and the outcome ACCEPT, REFER or DECLINE
byPath.Vehicle: The insured vehicle: make, model year, value and safety features
byPath.VehicleFacts: The age of the vehicle and the number of safety features
byPath.autoQuote: Quotes a policy: underwriting outcome, rating breakdown, discounts and premium
byPath.baseRate: The base rate by coverage, for every version of the rate table
byPath.deductibleFactor: The rating factor of the deductible; liability coverage has no deductible
byPath.discounts: Every discount that the policy earns
byPath.driverAgeFactor: The rating factor of the driver age
byPath.driverUnderwriting: The underwriting rules of one driver: each matching rule declines or refers the policy
byPath.drivingRecordFactor: The rating factor of the at-fault claims and the minor violations
byPath.experienceFactor: The rating factor of the years since the driving licence
byPath.familyBook: A family car with three drivers, quoted now and again after the rate change of January 2027
byPath.familyBook.quote: The quote on the quote date
byPath.familyBook.requote: The quote of the same policy on 4 January 2027, with the 2027 rate table
byPath.rateVersion: The rate table in force on the quote date
byPath.ratingPolicy: The parameters of the rating policy: the discount cap and the charge for monthly payment
byPath.requoteOn: Quotes the same policy on another date, for example after a rate change
byPath.territoryFactor: The rating factor of the territory
byPath.vehicleFactor: The rating factor of the vehicle value and age; liability coverage does not rate the vehicle
